title: Final fixes: what changed from your final-review answers

steps.headline: The fixes from your answers on the final review — each slide quotes what you wrote and shows before and after.
steps.changed: Before is the branch as you saw it on the final review; Now is the branch today. Pictures are in your theme (Halftone Dimension) and one light theme (Meadow Mist) — the swatches at the top switch. Checked today: the full desktop check, Android tests, documentation links and the deck tool's tests (numbers on the last slide).
steps.notice: One question near the end: the take-over popups. The last slide lists what is still not done.

steps.headline: The new design guide is approved and in use; the old one is archived.

steps.path: Open a session another device is using
steps.headline: Should the two take-over popups get a short title and a ✕, like every other popup?
steps.today: When a conversation is open on another device that cannot be reached, a small popup explains it and offers Never mind or Take over. There are two versions (could not confirm, and cannot be reached). Neither has a title or a ✕.
steps.problem: Every other popup has a title at the top and a ✕ to close it (the guide's popup rule). These two start straight with their text, so they look unfinished and the only way out is a button.
steps.proposal: Add the titles “Take over this conversation?” and “That device can’t be reached”, and the ✕ (it does the same as Never mind).
